title: MartisDux life-size Mars walk terrain

start.name: Perseverance landing site (Octavia E. Butler Landing)

tint.note: Average Viking MDIM 2.1 colour between 50°S and 50°N, applied as a luminance-preserving hue to monochrome imagery.

frame: Planetocentric latitude, east-positive longitude, Mars 2000 sphere (radius 3,396,190 m). Heights are areoid elevations applied as radial offsets.
reconstruction: A reconstruction from archived orbital mission data. Not live imagery and not current conditions on Mars.

layers.name: Mars · whole planet

dem.label: USGS HRSC/MOLA blended DEM v2
dem.note: Level-2 service tiles (≈5.2 km) filtered and decimated to a ≈10.4 km grid for the whole-planet mesh.

imagery.label: Viking MDIM 2.1 colour mosaic
imagery.note: Bundled 8,192 × 4,096 version of the official 1 km browse product (2.6 km/px at the equator).

layers.credit: DEM: NASA/MGS/MOLA, ESA/DLR/FU Berlin HRSC, USGS; Esri LERC tiles. Imagery: NASA/JPL/USGS/NASA Ames.

layers.name: Jezero region · Isidis rim

dem.label: USGS HRSC/MOLA blended DEM v2
dem.note: Level-7 service tiles, unchanged samples (grid finer than the ≈200 m source; no added detail).

imagery.label: MRO CTX V01 global mosaic (monochrome)
imagery.note: Level-9 tiles (≈41 m/px), one native tile per chunk.

layers.credit: DEM: NASA/MGS/MOLA, ESA/DLR/FU Berlin HRSC, USGS. Imagery: NASA/JPL/MSSS/Caltech Murray Lab; tiles Esri.

layers.name: Jezero crater floor & delta

dem.label: NASA/USGS Jezero HiRISE DTM (Mars 2020 TRN)
dem.note: Every 16th native 1 m sample. 34% of this box has no HiRISE DTM; there the 200 m HRSC/MOLA DEM is used, blended over 350 m.

layers.credit: DTM: NASA/JPL-Caltech/University of Arizona/USGS. Imagery: NASA/JPL/MSSS/Caltech Murray Lab; tiles Esri.

layers.name: Perseverance landing area

dem.label: NASA/USGS Jezero HiRISE DTM (Mars 2020 TRN)
dem.note: Native 1 m samples (2,049 × 2,049), unchanged; heights quantised to 0.05 m for delivery.

imagery.label: HiRISE Jezero orthomosaic (monochrome)
imagery.note: Level-17 Mars Trek tiles (the service maximum), native pixels (26 × 26 tiles); one page per 128 m chunk.

layers.credit: DTM and imagery: NASA/JPL-Caltech/University of Arizona/USGS.
